question: Can the full network sustain repeated post-cue joint bends without periodic pacing?
mode: fresh search for new task, not exact optimizer resume
numerical_checks: Same coarse joint qualifies at fine resolutions; amplitude difference<=25% max(target,coarse amp), peak/trough counts differ<=1; retain matched cue-effect checks
controls: Chemical block removes cue recruitment/differential response; held voltage has no qualifying pattern; actual-body proprioception active and blocking descriptive; sham short patterns reported independently
artifacts: External selected/final parameters, RNG, recursive lineage, source/env/invocation and dense active/sham traces
limitation: Slow oscillatory ringdown can qualify in this short window; this does not demonstrate a stable limit cycle
